analysis_steps.goal: Fit torus size and orientation in visibilities

method.value: UV_FIT to visibilities within r<=0.2'' of AGN

evidence.quote: We have used the GILDAS task `UV_FIT` to find the best-fit to the visibilities inside a radius $r\leq0.2\ensuremath{''}$ (14 pc) from the AGN.
The fit indicates that half of the total flux in this region stems from a spatially resolved ellipsoidal disk, characterized by a deconvolved diameter of $7\pm1$ pc

validation.value: Residuals inspected; uniform-weighted image shows goodness of fit

evidence.quote: The enhanced spatial resolution of the uniformly-weighted data set better illustrates the goodness of the fit

analysis_steps.goal: Derive torus dust and gas mass

method.value: Modified black body to 13.8 mJy flux at 432 um, then gas-to-dust ratio

evidence.quote: To estimate $M_{\rm dust}^{\rm torus}$ we used a modified black-body function

assumptions.value: T_dust = T_gas = 150 K, beta=2, kappa_694GHz=0.34 m2/kg, gas-to-dust 60, max 18% non-thermal flux

evidence.quote: a dust temperature $T_{\rm dust} \simeq T_{\rm gas}=150$ K, an emissivity index $\beta=2$, and a value for the dust emissivity $\kappa_{{\rm 694~GHz}}$=0.34 m$^2$ kg$^{-1}$

analysis_steps.goal: Fit nuclear SED with CLUMPY models

method.value: Bayesian fit with BayesClumpy; sigma 40-60 deg, Y 5-30, inclination 60-90 deg (and 30-90 deg alternative)

evidence.quote: The torus radial extent, defined by the outer–to–inner radius ratio $Y$, is in the range $5<Y<30$ based on the torus size measured by ALMA at 432 $\mu$m.

fitting.value: Bayesian with priors on six parameters; medians reported

evidence.quote: adopting a Bayesian approach using the `BayesClumpy` tool (cite: Ase09). This scheme has been applied to model the SED of other Seyferts (cite: Alo11; Ram11). Using this approach we can specify a priori information about the six model parameters.

claims.hypothesis: The submillimeter counterpart of the torus can be resolved with ALMA
claims.experiment: Band 9 imaging at ~4 pc and UV_FIT
claims.result: 7-10 pc disk in dust and CO at the AGN
claims.finding: First detection of the submillimeter torus

evidence.quote: This is the first detection of a submillimeter counterpart of the putative torus of .

claims.experiment: BayesClumpy fit of the nuclear SED
claims.result: Mgas 0.9e5 Msun, R 4 pc vs ALMA 1e5 Msun

evidence.quote: These values are consistent with those derived in Sect [3](#maps) from the Band 9 observations alone.

claims.hypothesis: The torus is edge-on like the maser disk
claims.experiment: Compare p-v with the maser rotation curve; SED fit with a wider inclination range
claims.result: CO velocities >=2 times lower than for edge-on
claims.finding: The torus may be less inclined (34-66 deg) at larger radii; PPI suggested

evidence.quote: we have found evidence that the molecular torus could be tilted towards lower inclination angles ($i=34\ensuremath{^\circ}-66\ensuremath{^\circ}$) at $r\geq2-4$ pc
